A.prompt: Write 3 or 4 sentences about your best friend. Say the name, the age and one thing your friend has. Model sentence: My cousin is six.
A.answerKey: My best friend is Maya. She is eight years old. She has a small brown dog. She is very funny.
acceptedAnswers: My best friend is Yusuf. He is twelve. He has a red bike. He is tall and kind.
My friend's name is Leila. She is nine years old. She has two brothers.

task.0: Nothing is written about the topic.

task.2: All asked points but one are written about the topic.
task.3: Every asked point is written about the topic.

language.0: Four or more errors, or the text is one line with no full stops.
language.3: No errors: every sentence has a capital, a full stop and am/is/are or have/has where needed.

rubric.errorCount: One error = a missing capital at the start of a sentence or in "I", a missing full stop, a missing or wrong am/is/are, or a wrong have/has.
rubric.mastery: Criterion met when task >= 2 and language >= 2 (outcome: level 2 of 3 on every criterion).
